activity_summary: After dinner you asked Joan to tell Anne that you had heard how the three answers sounded. Joan refused. She said she was not a lane between two houses, and that you could walk to Anne yourself.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked Joan to tell Anne he had heard himself.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused to carry a word between them.

facets.activity: Asked Joan to tell Anne, and she said to walk

quotes.speaker: joan_shakespeare
quotes.text: Tell her yourself. I am not a lane between two houses.
